name: Dark mech, left column
note: Round 11: a column the height of the screen on the left, 372 units wide, C&C's sidebar in this kit, in one size. Modules bolted to an armoured spine with a light down its inner edge: the clock, APM and the Game Menu over the minimap, Diplomacy or Terrain, Messaging, idle and army under it; the ten groups in two rows of five over Hyperion's selection; the portrait beside the card at the foot. The resources hang from the top of the screen, right of centre or at the right edge as the player picks, on a plate or none. At Width 16:9 the column stands where a 16:9 screen has it, in from the edge of a wider one, and the side past it is plated. Built by huds/kits/build-mech.mjs from the parts in mech-parts.mjs. Hyperion's copy: no game timer in the skin; the time slot and its cell are left out. No flash on a new selection.

options.label: Width
options.help: 16:9 keeps the column where a 16:9 screen has it, in from the edge of a wider one, and plates the side past it. On a 16:9 screen or a narrower one the two are the same.

values.label: Full screen
values.help: The HUD runs the width of the screen.
The HUD keeps to the middle of a wider screen, as wide as a 16:9 screen's.

options.label: Resources
options.help: Right of centre is where classic StarCraft has them, the top right of the screen's middle 4:3, so on a wide screen they stay near the middle. Right edge puts them in the top right corner, however wide the screen.

options.label: Resources backing
options.help: The plate behind minerals, gas and supply, with its cells and lights. With none, the icons and figures stand on the map, as they do in classic StarCraft.
